name: Llama 3.3 70B
context_scaling: llama3 rope scaling (factor 8 from an 8192 base)
notes: PARAMS: 70.55B is the safetensors count. KV: 80 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 bytes = 327,680 bytes/token = 320 KiB/token. Compare with the 8B model: 2.5x the KV per token of an 8B at the same context. At 128k that is 40 GiB of KV for a single sequence, which is the practical reason 70B-class GQA serving is context-limited, not weight-limited. 8 kv heads against 64 query heads is the most aggressive GQA ratio in common deployment. SOURCE CAVEAT: unsloth mirror of Meta weights, not first-party.
